section.title: Appearance
section.description: How Plinthio looks for you. Changes show in the preview and save straight away, for your account only.
section.locked: Your admin sets how Plinthio looks on this server, so these can't be changed here. The preview shows what everyone sees.

language.desc: The language Plinthio speaks to you. Automatic follows your browser.

accent.title: Accent colour
accent.desc: Your highlight colour on buttons, badges and the current tab.

pageWidth.title: Page width
pageWidth.desc: How wide pages get on a big screen. Full width fits more posters in a row.

pauseScreen.title: Pause screen
pauseScreen.desc: What appears after a couple of seconds paused on a movie or episode.

textSize.title: Text size
textSize.desc: Makes text and controls bigger or smaller on this device. Each device keeps its own size.

themeMode.title: Light or dark
themeMode.desc: Match device follows your device's own light or dark setting as it changes.

font.title: Font
font.desc: The lettering across Plinthio on this device. Books keep their own font, set in the reader.

posterSize.title: Poster size
posterSize.desc: How big posters and covers are on your shelves. Compact fits more in a row.

motion.title: Motion
motion.label: Reduce motion
motion.desc: Things appear instead of sliding, fading or zooming. Plinthio already does this when your device asks for reduced motion.

full.label: Full Width
full.desc: Use the whole screen, fitting more posters

simple.label: Simple
simple.desc: Just the player controls — nothing covers the picture.

details.label: Details
details.desc: Poster, title, tagline, synopsis, director and cast, and when it will end.

cinematic.label: Cinematic
cinematic.desc: The picture dims behind a full-screen title card with cast photos and facts from TMDB — box office, original title, keywords.

bedtime.label: Bedtime
bedtime.desc: A dim clock with the time it ends and, for shows, when the rest of the season would. Easy on the eyes in a dark room.

defaultLanguage.title: Default language
defaultLanguage.desc: For everyone who hasn't picked their own. Automatic follows each person's browser; people can always choose another in Settings.

device.title: This device
device.desc: These are kept on this device, so your phone, computer and TV can each look the way that suits them.

legible.label: Atkinson Hyperlegible
legible.desc: Letters drawn to be hard to mix up. Good for low vision.

dyslexic.label: OpenDyslexic
dyslexic.desc: Weighted letters that some readers with dyslexia find easier.

subtitles.title: Subtitles
subtitles.desc: Whether subtitles are on when a video starts. You can always switch them in the player.
subtitles.hint: A video without subtitles in that language starts without them. Before an anime episode plays in another language with no subtitles showing, Plinthio asks how you want to watch it.

on.label: On
on.desc: Videos start with subtitles when they have them.
